column1: # *** THE ELEVENTH LERENA MARRIAGE DISPENSATION - Arquidiocesis de Montevideo, July-August 1911 ***
# Ark 3:1:3Q9M-C9B7-GS3N-1. FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT READ, 14 September 2026.
# Found by searching for the compound "Lerena Lerena" - which this file does NOT contain as a surname.
# *** WHAT MAKES IT UNUSUAL: THE PETITION DRAWS ITS OWN FAMILY TREE. *** Under the heading "Esquemas
# explicativos de los grados de parentesco" the Cura Vicario Angel D. Navea sets out two lines by hand.
# *** THE TWO ROWS BELOW WERE CORRECTED 27 SEPTEMBER 2026: FLORENCIA -> FLORINDA. *** They were
# transcribed from the machine transcript on 14 September and carried FLORENCIA for a week. The image
# read of 21 September, set out at the foot of this file, has her name in the priest's own hand in
# BOTH diagrams as FLORINDA. The column says "the diagram says", so it now says what the diagram says.
# The retraction is corrections.tsv:104, and the five register rows it names were fixed at the time;
# this working log was the one place the old reading survived.

column1: # *** SO: TWO LERENA SIBLINGS MARRIED TWO CARDOZO SIBLINGS, and a generation later their children -
# CUSTODIO LERENA and EMA CARDOZO - petitioned to marry each other. DOUBLE FIRST COUSINS, *** which is
# why the dispensation runs to a diagram: the tie has to be traced twice.
# They asked to be excused the fee: "en cuanto a los honorarios de esta dispensa piden se les EXONERE
# de ellos pues NO PUEDEN SATISFACERLOS." *** A poor Lerena household, which is worth recording in an
# archive that has spent two days finding generals, judges and hacendados. *** This family was not all
# of one class.
# ================ *** AND A MARIA LERENA ON A DOCUMENT *** ================
# The standing question of this whole archive is the MARIA LERENA named on Pablo Armando's 1908
# enrolment card as his mother. *** THIS IS THE FIRST DOCUMENTED MARIA LERENA OF ROUGHLY THE RIGHT
# GENERATION THIS ARCHIVE HAS FOUND. *** She has a daughter of marriageable age in 1911, so a birth in
# the 1850s or 1860s - the right window.
# *** AND SHE IS ALMOST CERTAINLY NOT THE ONE. *** She married ELISEO CARDOZO, where Pablo Armando's
# mother is named beside JUAN CARLOS LERENA. Recorded as a candidate ruled out on the record rather
# than a name left lying about, because this archive has twice built on a Maria it had not pinned down.
# *** AND THE STANDING CONCLUSION SURVIVES ITS HARDEST TEST YET. *** Eleven Lerena dispensations are
# now on file and *** EVERY LERENA IN EVERY ONE OF THEM MARRIES OUT *** - Cardozo here, Gavarro in
# 1892, Massera in 1913. The consanguinity in this one runs through the CARDOZOS as much as the
# Lerenas. Not one Lerena-Lerena union in seventy-six years of the register.
# ============ THE PLATE, OPENED 21 SEPTEMBER 2026 - AND THE PRIEST DREW THE TREE ============
# Film *** 007713362, image 02473 ***. IMAGE READ. The right-hand folio is not prose at all: it is
# *** "Esquema explicativo de los grados de parentesco" ***, TWO KINSHIP DIAGRAMS the priest drew
# himself, with circles for each degree and the names written beside them.
#   1o  Por parte del padre del novio y de la madre de la novia
#          BERNABE LERENA
#       Bernabe Lerena            Maria Lerena
#       casose con                casose con
#       FLORINDA CARDOZO          Eliseo Cardozo
#       Custodio Lerena           Ema Cardozo
#   2o  Por la madre del novio y el padre de la novia
#          CUSTODIO CARDOZO
#       Florinda Cardozo          Eliseo Cardozo
#       casada con                casado con
#       Bernabe Lerena            Maria Lerena
#       Custodio Lerena           Ema Cardozo
# *** THE NAME THIS ARCHIVE HAD WRONG: FLORINDA, NOT FLORENCIA. *** Written twice, in two separate
# diagrams, in the same hand. The machine transcript gave FLORENCIA and five register rows carried
# it for a week.
# *** AND THE DIAGRAM NAMES TWO PEOPLE THIS ARCHIVE NEVER HELD: *** the apex of each schema.
# *** BERNABE LERENA THE ELDER *** - father of Bernabe and Maria - and *** CUSTODIO CARDOZO ***,
# father of Florinda and Eliseo. A whole generation above the 1911 couple, drawn by the priest to
# prove the impediment, and read off a transcript that did not carry it into the register.
# *** IT ALSO EXPLAINS THE GROOM'S NAME. *** CUSTODIO LERENA is named for CUSTODIO CARDOZO, his
# mother's father - which is this family's habit in every generation this archive has read, from
# Pedro Alberto Ysabelino in 1852 to Angel Miguel Avelino in 1898.
